description: 14 steps with two players and a scene built with /setblock: a trapped chest opened by one player and then the other, an item moved in, each closing it; a double trapped chest opened and closed; a barrel and a chest opened and closed; the power of dust beside the trapped chest and beside the block below it, the dust beside the double trapped chest and a comparator reading the trapped chest, and the lid block events (positions, counts and rechecks) the first player receives; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
